en: Nyeeeh...

<CLT=cltMIND>She looks really bothered
by something.

Um, Himiko?
There's something I wanted to ask you.

Nyeeeh? 
My magic's a trade secret.

No, that's not it... I was wondering
why you became a magician.

Ah, sorry, a "mage." You said you had
a master, did he inspire you?

Hm, when I saw my master use his 
magic, I awakened as a mage.
...Um, just making sure, but...

Did your master also say he was
a mage, not a magician?

Huh? My master is known around 
the world as a legendary mage.
I see...

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko insisting she's a "mage" is
probably her master's influence.

The first time I saw my master was on
the stage during his magic show.

The magic he performed
was miraculous...

Seeing it triggered the magic powers 
sleeping within me to awaken.

But I didn't yet have the skill to 
control such powerful magic...

Therefore, I studied under my master 
to control my own magic.
I-I see...

Fortunately, it only took a few years of 
training to become a full-fledged mage.

Master let me help in his show as 
an assistant while I trained.

My master taught me the fundamentals 
of magic. Because he trained me...

People started calling me 
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Mage<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltMIND>She's actually the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Magician<CLT=cltMIND>,
but I probably shouldn't bring that up.

My master learned his magic by 
studying around the world, you know?

Extreme Wind Magic, "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Levitation<CLT=cltNORMAL>"...
Extreme Space Magic, "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Teleport<CLT=cltNORMAL>"...

Extreme Meat Magic, "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Sawing A Person 
In Half<CLT=cltNORMAL>"...and many more.

<CLT=cltMIND>"Extreme Meat Magic"...doesn't sound...
very magical...

My master made them all look simple, 
but...they were hard for me to grasp.

I want to teach you the basics, but the
stars aren't aligned right now, so...
Ah, I see...

Nyeeeh, so in return, this <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Mage<CLT=cltNORMAL> 
will answer any question for you.
It's not real magic, right?
When people get sawed in half...
What if a fly gets in your teleportation?
Are you unsure of something?

<CLT=cltMIND>A question?
Let me think...

It's not real magic, it's just
tricks, right?
Go on...ask your question.

...It's not real magic,
it's just tricks, right?

It's magic, it's magic, it's magic, it's magic,
it's magic, it's magic, it's magic, it's...

magic it's magic it's magic it's magic it's 
magic it's magic it's magic iiit's maaagic!!!

...I'm sorry.
You're right, it's magic.
Hmph, it's magic.

When people get sawed in half,
how do you put them back together?

Nyeeeh...it's...with magic, you know?
Like, you activate the cells and...

W-Well something like that.
You probably wouldn't get it...
Don't think, feel.
Is that right...?

What happens if a fly touches you
during teleportation...?

Hm... Then you'd be face to face
with danger...

But these days, spells are warded 
against interference from flies.
Good idea.

Even the Sawing Spell. It's great for 
when you want to make flies go away.

I don't think you should be cutting up
a body just to keep away flies...

In any case...I'm sure your master
is worried about you right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Hm? Is something wrong?
Himiko's mood changed...

Well, maybe...
He might...be worried...
Himiko?

I'm too tired to talk.
I'm going back to my room.

Ah, okay.
See you later then...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Himiko's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>I watched Himiko walk away,
and I returned to my room.

<CLT=cltMIND>Himiko was acting strange for a minute
there. I wonder what's wrong...
